name: Jak kozaky do zamku Drakuly hodyli
original_name: Як козаки до замку Дракули ходили
source: Two friends decide to spend the night in Dracula's castle in Transylvania. But who could have known that these two friends would turn out to be Ukrainians...
translation: Two friends decide to spend the night in Dracula's castle in Transylvania. But who could have known that these two friends would turn out to be Ukrainians...
